environment: Initial browser audit on isolated SQLite; follow-up production build and complete integration tests against temporary PostgreSQL; QR browser cases use Next production/NestJS/Prisma/PostgreSQL; no real database or messages used

findings.issue: Guest capacity filter eliminates all entries
findings.resolution: Nullable guest_capacity persists on creation and edits; Merchant form accepts whole numbers 1–1000; public listing filters 1–8, 9–14, 15+ and unspecified; edits require Admin review and retain QR.

findings.issue: Gallery route is placeholder text only, no property gallery
findings.resolution: Gallery loads actual published property photos and opens each correct QR profile

findings.issue: Social pages are prototype text without outbound links
findings.resolution: Validated configured outbound links; clear email/contact fallback when unconfigured; added NEXT_PUBLIC_LINE_URL

findings.issue: Auto payment verification has no integrated provider in current configuration; manual review remains required
findings.resolution: User requires human review only. AUTO UI removed, settings API rejects AUTO, effective mode always MANUAL, migration normalizes legacy settings; no provider integration required.

findings.issue: Public about/contact/help/guide copy still describes prototype, footer year fixed at 2025
findings.resolution: Updated public copy and dynamic footer year

findings.issue: Merchant navigation repeats React key owner-package for Package and Payment; React emitted duplicate key warnings
findings.evidence: Next development server browser console logged repeated duplicate key owner-package warnings
findings.resolution: Navigation keys include destination and label

findings.issue: Local Facebook OAuth has no FACEBOOK_APP_ID or FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET
findings.scope: Local .env only; hosted configuration not inspected
findings.resolution: User confirmed Meta approval is pending; activation/live login verification deferred until approved.

findings.issue: Local email delivery is not configured: SMTP_HOST missing; Email OTP template exists but THAIBULKSMS_API_KEY and THAIBULKSMS_API_SECRET missing
findings.scope: Local .env only; real sending not attempted
findings.resolution: User confirmed trial service is in use and paid activation awaits employer payment in the evening; live delivery not attempted.

findings.issue: Scan success text claims VillaCheck VERIFIED immediately after QR decoding, before backend eligibility validation
findings.evidence: Source review; expired/unregistered QR correctly rejected on subsequent verification page
findings.resolution: Reading a QR now says its property status is being checked

findings.issue: Admin Payments route renders no invoice/payment review panels despite submitted invoice in PostgreSQL
findings.evidence: functional-final.json: Admin Payments page exposes submitted invoice for review
findings.impact: Admin must use Villa list to inspect/reject/confirm slips; Payments navigation cannot complete the workflow
reproduce: Open Admin Payments: invoice panels absent
Open Admin Villas: same invoice and review controls appear
findings.resolution: Billing pages render deduplicated invoice panels for both Admin and Merchant, with Admin review controls

findings.issue: Hero previous-slide button is overlapped by slide indicator and cannot receive a normal pointer click at desktop viewport
findings.evidence: functional-final.json: Hero arrows and featured carousel navigate
findings.impact: Next arrow, dots and featured carousel pass; previous arrow is intercepted by hero-slide-indicator
findings.resolution: Slide indicator moved below photo arrows

findings.issue: Public Last checked is populated from creation time instead of last Admin review
findings.resolution: Uses Admin reviewed_at; unknown review dates remain unknown; createdAt is separate

findings.issue: Suspended/cancelled subscriptions with a future expiry display expired-package guidance
findings.resolution: Suspended/cancelled notices and renewal/upgrade controls match lifecycle; Backend rejects blocked renewals

findings.issue: Starter promises downloadable QR, but current VillaQr renders SVG and link without QR download action; document/slip download actions are distinct
findings.resolution: SVG download tested and its image scanned back to original Villa QR

findings.issue: Monthly pricing is displayed as per month while first paid invoice grants three months; later renewals grant one month
findings.resolution: Confirmed first monthly payment grants 3 months and renewals 1; explanatory copy present in pricing, promotion and Merchant selection

limitations: Live Google/LINE/Facebook OAuth provider flows, SMS/Email delivery, SMTP and slip provider not exercised; presence of credentials is not proof of validity
Physical iPhone/Android cameras not exercised; QR PNG decoding and simulated camera denial passed in Chrome mobile viewport
Hosted deployment configuration, HTTPS routing and hosted database not inspected
Cold backup test covers stopped dummy PostgreSQL; not an online backup or hosted point-in-time recovery test
Initial page rendering coverage does not imply every control and input permutation tested
